meta.what: One normalized row per row of the PSI 'Experimental table' CSVs (NASA Physical Sciences Informatics).
meta.row_numbering: row = record number in the CSV with the header as record 0 (first data row = 1; spreadsheet line = row + 1)
meta.id: <psi_id>:<row>, or <psi_id>:<table key>:<row> when the investigation has two tables
meta.citation: a table row cites as PSI id + table_file + row

row_kind.test: one row is one test (or one burn sample)
row_kind.test_day: one row is one day of testing with several flames (ACME BRE, CLD Flame, E-FIELD Flames, s-Flame, SLICE)
row_kind.test_series: one row is one fuel with the ranges tested for it (FLEX-2)
row_kind.test_group_reference: a row that names a material and points to the conditions of other rows (SAME rows 5-8)
row_kind.dataset_index: one data set of a ground investigation, not a test (PSI-142)

fields.o2_percent: percent O2; null unless a cell gives one clean number. o2_basis says what it describes: 'ambient' (the atmosphere around the fuel) or 'burner_stream' (inverse flames: O2 fed through the burner into a fuel atmosphere). summaries[].o2_percent_by_basis gives the range per basis; only 'ambient' compares with a cabin atmosphere
fields.pressure_kpa: kPa, converted from the unit the table uses
fields.flow_cm_s: cm/s as the table gives it
fields.composition: ambient mole fractions as written, only for tables that list them (FLEX, CFI)
fields.multi: core fields whose cell holds a list or a range: {field: {kind: list|range, values: [...]}}, values already converted
fields.approx: fields whose cell (or header) marks the number as approximate ('~', 'approx')
fields.conditions: other mapped test conditions: {name: {value, unit, raw}}; 'values' + 'kind' when the cell is a list or range
fields.outcomes: mapped results: {name: {value, unit, raw}}; an outcome measured at another gravity carries 'gravity'
fields.fuel: tidy name; null when the cell does not name the material. fuel_raw is the cell as written
fields.fuel_phase / fuel_form: only when the table or the PSI record states it; tables[].fuel_phase_source / fuel_form_source say where
fields.gravity: from the PSI record field project_type; tables[].gravity_source
fields.platform: from the PSI record field platform; hardware is the record's hardware field
fields.duplicate_of: id of an earlier row of the same table with identical cells
fields.raw: every cell of the row, as written, keyed by column name

meta.sanity_gates: o2_percent within 0..100; mole fraction within 0..1; pressure_kpa above 0; a cell outside gives null and stays raw
